sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Rangers Third Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CVI OF 1996
ORDINANCE CVI OF
1996
PAKISTAN RANGERS (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further
to amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959), for
the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly
is not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(I) This Ordinance may be called the
Pakistan Rangers (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Whereas it is expedient further

And whereas the National Assembly

render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 3,
W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959.‑‑In the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance,
1959 (XIV of 1959), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section
3, in subsection (4), for the words "Force shall be administered by the
Director‑General" the words and commas "Federal Government
shall, for administration of the Force, appoint Director‑General"
shall be substituted.
